name: marktplaats-watcher
description: Use Marktplaats Watcher from your agent to search listings and review your own watches and scored alerts.

interface.longDescription: Watch Marktplaats listings and review scored alerts with your agent. Search public listings and review your own saved watches and matches. You sign in to your Marktplaats Watcher account; the service can create, change, pause or archive watches with an Undo e-mail for each change, and prepare an offer draft for your review. It does not send seller messages or place bids.
capabilities: Review saved watches and scored alerts
